name: Upscale model (ComfyUI)
description: An upscale model from the server's models/upscale_models folder (ESRGAN, UltraSharp, DAT, ...), picked under Settings as Model. The selection's box goes out at its own size, without a fill or the reference layers, the model enlarges it by its own factor, and the node's stitch fits the answer back into the box: a sharper detail pass at the document's resolution. The whole picture is not upscaled on this route (the node's stitch has no way to replace the base).
